Messages.Author: Catwoman
Messages.Body:
Seems like the following of this game is even smaller than I thought. I
have been playing Jyhad (or whatever) since the day it arrived at the
stores some 2 (or was it 3) years ago. For a while, when I lived in
Miami, fla, I played ALOT but ever since I moved from there last year I
haven't been able to find a game. I poked around a little on the net and
here I am.

Hi!

I have a few questions for the people (or person) who frequent here.
Does anyone do any trading by mail (much less risky than MtG trading)??
Do people have games on the net somewhere (IRC, or some cool MUSH)?? If
so, who is willing to take on Miami, Fla's former master of the Jyhad??

As far as trading goes I recently damaged (or lost) about 4 cards from my
complete Jyhad set and am willing to trade by mail to get them back.
I need the following:
Ghoul Escort
Police Department
Brujah Justicar
and I would love to get a hold of a couple more FISTS OF DEATH!

I am DYING to play a game against someone. so please respond to this. If
there is indeed somebody out there.

Anxiously awaiting response,
Nick Hernandez

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Catwoman <damc...@mtholyoke.edu> writes:
> I have a few questions for the people (or person) who frequent here.
>Does anyone do any trading by mail (much less risky than MtG trading)??

Sure. I've been party to eight or so trades, and never been stiffed
yet. References should still be requested and offered if your
barter partner isn't well known.

>Do people have games on the net somewhere (IRC, or some cool MUSH)?? If
>so, who is willing to take on Miami, Fla's former master of the Jyhad??

Sure. Jyhad On-Line (JOL) is going on over e-mail (not the speedy
response of IRC, but who wants to sit at an IRC session for five
hours straight, anyhow?):

The system is administered by George Fink.
http://shangrila.cs.ucdavis.edu:1234/gfink/jol/jol.html
